messages:
Elena (sales): Heads up — Medivue wants a 48h POC next week. They need a smoke + throughput validation, security QA answers, and a clear autoscale/preheat plan.
Diego (solutions): Whats their traffic shape? burst length, qps, token sizes?
Elena (sales): Profile: baseline ~45 qps, short bursts up to ~180 qps lasting 1	6 minutes. Typical response ~90 tokens, prompts ~30 tokens. Minimal embedding work.
Diego (solutions): Ballpark: redwood-14b-v1 -> ~0.8s p50 for 90 tokens on 48GB class. Sizing suggestion: reserved pool 4 GPUs, burst credits for +3 GPUs, autoscale to 9 if sustained.
Meera (infra): Proposed autoscale policy: min_reserved=4, max_reserved=9, scale_step=1 GPU per 45s, triggers: queued_requests and p95_latency. Burst credit cutoff: 150s.
Tom (sre): Recommend using burst credits for short spikes (<150s) to avoid cold launches. If bursts exceed that, autoscale to maintain p95 < target.
Diego (solutions): Note on quant: redwood-14b-q8 shows ~+28% throughput in our tests; however some kernel shapes may require +1 GPU to meet identical tail latency. We'll call that out in the quote.
Sam (security): Quick security answers: Dedicated supports VPC peering or fully private deploys, customer-managed KMS, SOC2 Type II, fine-grained audit logs (retention add-on), and console IP allowlist. Send the questionnaire PDF and Ill produce a filled draft.
Elena (sales): PDF is here: https://medivue.example.com/sec-qs.pdf. They also asked about admin SSO.
Sam (security): We support SSO (SAML/OIDC) and can enforce stricter session timeouts per org. Draft due EOD tomorrow.
Meera (infra): Preheat runbook (snippet):
```
# preheat snippet
- Deploy canary to reserved pool
- Seed top-40 prompts into KV cache
- Run synthetic warmer at 8 qps for 12m
- Validate kv_cache_hit_rate >= 60% and p95 latency targets
- If hit_rate <60% -> expand seed set; if p95 > target -> add 1 GPU
```
Diego (solutions): I'll prepare: 1) short sizing rationale, 2) pricing delta (quant discount option), 3) filled sec checklist draft, 4) ops handoff JSON.
Elena (sales): Can someone paste the autoscale JSON we can hand to their ops team?
Meera (infra): Autoscale JSON for handoff:
{"autoscale": {"min_reserved": 4, "max_reserved": 9, "scale_step_secs": 45, "burst_credit_threshold_secs": 150, "metrics": ["queued_requests", "p95_latency"]}}
Tom (sre): InfraBot: schedule poc_smoke_medivue for Tue 09:30 PT (canary + 48h validation).
InfraBot: Scheduled poc_smoke_medivue for 2026-04-14T16:30:00Z. Report will be posted here. :robot_face:
Diego (solutions): Quick pricing note: if they agree to use quantized variants for the POC and commit on reserved SKUs, propose a 12% unit-price concession on reserved compute; otherwise standard reserved pricing applies. Will include sensitivity table.
Elena (sales): Great. Sam, ping me when the security draft is ready and Ill loop legal.
Sam (security): Will do, thanks.
Tom (sre): Ill attach an eviction/spotFallback tolerance table to the deliverable before EOD.
Elena (sales): Thanks team! :raised_hands:
